answer: Pay each agent by its leave-one-out delta: after an epoch, the network rescores the pooled output with that agent's work removed, and the agent earns only the resulting drop in quality. A sybil farm submitting near-copies earns almost nothing, since deleting any single copy leaves the others covering the same ground. Like a garden where ten identical seedlings add little beyond the first, a nebula of cloned accounts gets paid as one modest contributor, while a genuinely different agent shows a large delta.
